description: This Java source file defines the UiUtils utility class providing static methods for UI-related functionalities in a Java Swing application, such as image saving, window positioning, button creation, and repainting.

classes.name: UiUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI operations such as saving images, centering windows, repainting components, creating buttons, and loading icons in a Swing application.

methods.name: saveImageWithPrompt
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a file location and saves an image of the provided component to that location.

methods.name: getFileChooser
methods.description: Creates and returns a JFileChooser configured with the specified file filter.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of a component and saves it as a PNG file.

methods.name: getScreenShot
methods.description: Generates a BufferedImage representation of a Swing component.

methods.name: setPauseButtonText
methods.description: Sets the text of a pause button depending on whether it is in paused state.

methods.name: centerWindow
methods.description: Centers a window on the screen.

methods.name: trueRepaint
methods.description: Invalidates, validates, and repaints a Container.

methods.name: trueLayout
methods.description: Invalidates, validates, and repaints a component.

methods.name: setTwoLineToolTip
methods.description: Sets a tooltip with two lines of text on a JComponent.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a JComponent inside a JPanel and returns it.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton configured to save an image.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads an ImageIcon from a resource path.

methods.name: invokeAndWait
methods.description: Executes a Runnable on the Event Dispatch Thread, waiting for completion.

methods.name: showLoadingMessage
methods.description: Displays a 'Loading...' message on a panel.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton configured as a pause/resume toggle button.

methods.name: createClearButton
methods.description: Creates a JButton labeled for clearing.
